settings.title: Desktop app
settings.description: Automatic backups, restore, start at login and local network mode for the other devices of the beach.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Full copies of the archive, restorable here or on an online instance with arenile restore.
backup.dirHint: Full path of the folder, also on a USB stick (for example E:\Arenile Backup or /Volumes/USB/Arenile).
backup.retentionHint: The oldest are deleted; manual backups are always kept.

system.title: Startup and updates
system.description: Arenile does not connect to the internet unless you enable it.
system.autostart: Start Arenile when the computer starts
system.autostartHint: Only for the current operating system user.
system.updateCheckHint: Once a day it reads the latest version number from the Coste360 website, without sending any data of the beach.

lan.title: Local network mode
lan.description: The other computers, tablets and phones of the staff work on the same archive over the beach Wi-Fi, with an encrypted connection. Connections from outside the network are refused.
lan.portHint: Default 8443. Change it only if another program already uses it.

empty.title: No backups
empty.description: The first automatic backup is made a few minutes after start. You can make one right away with “Back up now”.

restore.title: Restore this backup?
restore.message: Data will go back to how it was on {{date}}. The current archive is saved first as a “Before restore” backup, so the operation can be undone. Arenile restarts for a few seconds.
restore.inProgress: Arenile is restarting with the chosen backup: the page will reload by itself.

publicPage.title: Public page
publicPage.why: The desktop app runs on this computer without internet: customers cannot reach it, so the public page and the booking widget would make no sense.

payments.title: Online payments
payments.notice: Payments at the cash desk only
payments.why: Cash, card terminal, bank transfer and other methods are recorded from the cash desk and the booking. Online card payments need an instance reachable from the internet.

move.title: Moving to an online instance
move.description: The desktop app backup is the same archive as the server edition: it moves without conversions.
move.step2: Install Arenile on a VPS, a hosting or a server with Docker (guide “Choose how to install Arenile”).
move.step3: On the server, with Arenile stopped, restore the backup file:
move.step4: Start Arenile on the server and enable the public page and online payments from there.
move.noSync: The desktop app and the online instance do not synchronise: after the move, work only on the online instance (you can connect this app in remote mode).
